entries.title: Performance Review Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees receive formal performance reviews annually.

entries.title: Dress Code Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees are expected to dress in business casual attire.

entries.title: Warranty Policy
entries.policy_text: Products are covered under warranty for one year.

entries.title: Account Management Policy
entries.policy_text: Accounts must be reviewed quarterly.

entries.title: Anti-Harassment Policy
entries.policy_text: Harassment of any kind is not tolerated.

entries.title: Recognition Program Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may nominate peers for recognition awards.

entries.title: Software Installation Policy
entries.policy_text: Only approved software may be installed on company devices.

entries.title: Workplace Accommodation Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may request reasonable accommodations.

entries.title: Data Privacy Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must protect customer data and follow privacy regulations.

entries.title: Work From Abroad Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may work abroad for up to 30 days with approval.

entries.title: File Naming Policy
entries.policy_text: Files must follow naming conventions for easy retrieval.

entries.title: Company Vehicle Policy
entries.policy_text: Use of company vehicles must be logged and approved.

entries.title: Onboarding Policy
entries.policy_text: New hires must complete onboarding within their first week.

entries.title: Legal Hold Policy
entries.policy_text: Legal holds must be applied to relevant documents.

entries.title: Budget Planning Policy
entries.policy_text: Departments must submit budgets by Q4.

entries.title: Holiday Schedule Policy
entries.policy_text: Company holidays are published annually and observed accordingly.

entries.title: Support Ticket Policy
entries.policy_text: Support tickets must be resolved within SLA.

entries.title: Supplier Evaluation Policy
entries.policy_text: Suppliers must be evaluated annually.

entries.title: Parking Policy
entries.policy_text: Parking spaces are assigned and must be used accordingly.

entries.title: Equal Opportunity Policy
entries.policy_text: The company is committed to equal opportunity employment.

entries.title: Customer Interaction Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must maintain professionalism in all customer interactions.

entries.title: Customer Feedback Policy
entries.policy_text: Customer feedback must be logged and reviewed.

entries.title: Marketing Approval Policy
entries.policy_text: Marketing materials must be approved before release.

entries.title: Remote Work Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.

entries.title: Code of Conduct
entries.policy_text: All employees must adhere to professional behavior standards.

entries.title: Meeting Room Booking Policy
entries.policy_text: Meeting rooms must be booked in advance using the portal.

entries.title: Internal Communication Policy
entries.policy_text: Use company channels for internal communication.

entries.title: Mobile Device Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may request company-issued mobile devices for work.

entries.title: Training Reimbursement Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may be reimbursed for approved external training.

entries.title: Client Gift Policy
entries.policy_text: Client gifts must comply with company guidelines.

entries.title: Campaign Review Policy
entries.policy_text: Marketing campaigns must be reviewed quarterly.

entries.title: Employee Referral Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may refer candidates for open positions.

entries.title: Offer Letter Policy
entries.policy_text: Offer letters must follow approved templates.

entries.title: Work Anniversary Recognition Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees are recognized on their work anniversaries.

entries.title: Conflict of Interest Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must disclose any potential conflicts of interest.

entries.title: Business Continuity Policy
entries.policy_text: Departments must maintain business continuity plans.

entries.title: System Downtime Policy
entries.policy_text: Planned downtimes are communicated in advance.

entries.title: Hardware Upgrade Policy
entries.policy_text: Hardware upgrades must be requested through IT.

entries.title: Exit Interview Policy
entries.policy_text: Departing employees are encouraged to participate in an exit interview.

entries.title: Security Incident Policy
entries.policy_text: Security incidents must be reported immediately.

entries.title: Promotion Policy
entries.policy_text: Promotions are based on performance and business needs.

entries.title: Sales Incentive Policy
entries.policy_text: Sales incentives must be documented and approved.

entries.title: Probation Period Policy
entries.policy_text: New hires are subject to a 90-day probation period.

entries.title: Mentorship Program Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may participate in the mentorship program.

entries.title: Public Speaking Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must get approval before public speaking engagements.

entries.title: Sustainability Policy
entries.policy_text: Departments should consider sustainability in operations.

entries.title: Remote Access Policy
entries.policy_text: Remote access must use secure VPN connections.

entries.title: Incident Response Policy
entries.policy_text: Incident response procedures must be followed during disruptions.

entries.title: Inventory Management Policy
entries.policy_text: Inventory must be tracked and reconciled monthly.

entries.title: Asset Disposal Policy
entries.policy_text: IT assets must be disposed of securely.

entries.title: Office Access Policy
entries.policy_text: Access badges must be worn and not shared.

entries.title: Product Return Policy
entries.policy_text: Returns must follow the documented return process.

entries.title: Email Signature Policy
entries.policy_text: All employees must use the approved email signature format.

entries.title: Cloud Storage Policy
entries.policy_text: Use approved cloud storage for company documents.

entries.title: Shipping Policy
entries.policy_text: Shipping must use approved carriers.

entries.title: Social Media Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must not disclose confidential information on social media.

entries.title: Remote Meeting Policy
entries.policy_text: Remote meetings should use approved video conferencing tools.

entries.title: Interview Panel Policy
entries.policy_text: Interview panels must include diverse representation.

entries.title: Expense Approval Policy
entries.policy_text: All expenses over $500 require prior approval from Finance.

entries.title: Customer Onboarding Policy
entries.policy_text: New customers must complete onboarding steps.

entries.title: Document Retention Policy
entries.policy_text: Documents must be retained according to legal requirements.

entries.title: Cybersecurity Awareness Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must complete annual cybersecurity training.

entries.title: Corporate Card Policy
entries.policy_text: Corporate card usage must comply with expense guidelines.

entries.title: Flexible Hours Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may adjust work hours with manager approval.

entries.title: Sick Leave Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees accrue sick leave monthly for personal or family illness.

entries.title: Content Publishing Policy
entries.policy_text: Content must be reviewed before publishing.

entries.title: Home Office Equipment Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may request ergonomic equipment for remote work.

entries.title: Laptop Usage Policy
entries.policy_text: Company laptops must be used for business purposes only.

entries.title: Procurement Policy
entries.policy_text: All purchases must follow the procurement process.

entries.title: Bereavement Leave Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may take up to 5 days of bereavement leave.

entries.title: Disaster Recovery Policy
entries.policy_text: IT must maintain disaster recovery protocols.

entries.title: Petty Cash Policy
entries.policy_text: Petty cash usage must be documented and reconciled monthly.

entries.title: Brand Guidelines Policy
entries.policy_text: All materials must follow brand guidelines.

entries.title: Contract Review Policy
entries.policy_text: Contracts must be reviewed by Legal before signing.

entries.title: Parental Leave Policy
entries.policy_text: Eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

entries.title: Background Check Policy
entries.policy_text: All new hires must pass background checks.

entries.title: Tuition Assistance Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may apply for tuition assistance for approved programs.

entries.title: Internet Usage Policy
entries.policy_text: Company internet should be used for work-related activities only.

entries.title: Whistleblower Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may report unethical behavior anonymously.

entries.title: Exit Clearance Policy
entries.policy_text: Departing employees must complete exit clearance.

entries.title: Vendor Management Policy
entries.policy_text: Vendors must be approved and reviewed annually.

entries.title: Quality Assurance Policy
entries.policy_text: Products must pass quality checks before release.

entries.title: Conference Attendance Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees may attend conferences with prior approval.

entries.title: Media Contact Policy
entries.policy_text: Only authorized employees may speak to the media.

entries.title: Diversity and Inclusion Policy
entries.policy_text: The company promotes a diverse and inclusive workplace.

entries.title: Workplace Safety Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must follow safety procedures and report hazards.

entries.title: Workplace Cleanliness Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees are responsible for maintaining clean workspaces.

entries.title: Helpdesk Ticket Policy
entries.policy_text: All IT issues must be submitted via helpdesk ticket.

entries.title: Meeting Etiquette Policy
entries.policy_text: Meetings should start on time and follow an agenda.

entries.title: Lead Management Policy
entries.policy_text: Sales leads must be tracked in the CRM.

entries.title: IT Asset Management Policy
entries.policy_text: All IT assets must be tracked and returned upon exit.

entries.title: Password Policy
entries.policy_text: Passwords must be changed every 90 days and meet complexity requirements.

entries.title: Travel Reimbursement Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must submit receipts for travel expenses within 30 days.

entries.title: Press Release Policy
entries.policy_text: Press releases must be approved by Marketing and Legal.

entries.title: Vacation Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees receive 15 vacation days per year. Unused days may roll over.

entries.title: Escalation Policy
entries.policy_text: Customer issues must follow the escalation process.

entries.title: Job Posting Policy
entries.policy_text: All internal job postings are listed on the company portal.

entries.title: Company Property Policy
entries.policy_text: Employees must return company property upon exit.
